summary: Plan fulfills R01-R03: the robot fails on exhibition morning; Ada and Bora cooperate and discover the loose connector through the diagram and direct inspection; Bora repairs it with the established screwdriver; they choose and carry out an honest live demonstration. Resolutions are earned by events, and the trust change is only 'recovering', so no instant intimacy. Deadline pressure is plausible, no unestablished resources are used, and there are no semantic blockers.
